title: The Dartmouth Workshop: The $7,500 investment that gave birth to AI (2/2)
summary: Some 70 years before the current frenzy of record-breaking fundraising by modern AI giants such as OpenAI and Anthropic, the Rockefeller Foundation made what may have been the first investment in the history of AI.
